sections.label: The opening
sections.line: The US ground stop is a case for town planner teams that read, certify and test every line, with AI making that work scale.
sections.para: A network update, a reboot, a crash and five hours of no departures. Vincent Lextrait blamed AI slop; I agreed with caveats: we need the investigation's evidence, and systems like this belong to town planners, every line read and certified by an experienced team. AI belongs around the code: understanding, connecting, aligning and testing.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: What happened, the claim and the evidence, two caveats, and where AI belongs.

sections.label: The post and my reply
sections.line: Vincent Lextrait's post, and my reply: agree, but evidence first, and town planner mode for systems like this.
sections.para: His post blamed AI-assisted coding at L3Harris; my reply asked for evidence and a multidisciplinary team.

sections.label: What we know so far
sections.line: About five hours, over 4,000 cancellations; a network update, a reboot, a crash; no evidence yet of AI-written code.
sections.para: Officials blamed an old system and patches that overwhelmed routers; the FBI is looking at a software update; the vibe coding quote is CTO Andrew Puryear's.

sections.label: Town planner territory
sections.line: Explorers, villagers, town planners: an air traffic network is at the far end of the line.
sections.para: Every line read, and not by one person but by a team of engineers, architects, designers, testers, resilience and security.

sections.label: Where AI belongs in that pipeline
sections.line: AI belongs around the shipped code: understanding, connecting, alignment, testing and the NFRs.
sections.para: It gives the certifying team more evidence than ever, in time to use it.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: No claim about the cause, the companies' processes, or whether AI was involved.
sections.para: The facts are from news reports on 13 and 14 November.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The post and reply, CBS News, SecurityWeek, Shield Capital, and earlier newsroom articles.
